name: application_history_read
qual:
(( SELECT is_admin() AS is_admin) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (applications a
     JOIN jobs j ON ((j.id = a.job_id)))

name: applications_insert

   FROM jobs j
  WHERE ((j.id = applications.job_id) AND ((j.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'published'::text])) AND ((j.deadline IS NULL) OR (j.deadline >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Baku'::text))::date))))))

qual:
((id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR ( SELECT is_admin() AS is_admin) OR ((status = 'active'::account_status) AND (role = ANY (ARRAY['student'::user_role, 'graduate'::user_role])) AND ((EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((applications a
     JOIN jobs j ON ((j.id = a.job_id)))
     JOIN companies c ON ((c.id = j.company_id)))
  WHERE ((a.student_id = profiles.id) AND (c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (c.status = 'active'::account_status)))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((companies c
     JOIN subscriptions s ON (((s.company_id = c.id) AND (s.status = 'active'::text))))
     JOIN plan_features pf ON (((pf.plan_id = s.plan_id) AND (pf.feature_key = 'candidate_search'::text) AND pf.enabled)))
  WHERE ((c.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND (c.status = 'active'::account_status)))))))
